answer: A forge that issues one pearl licence per agent can hold the line: to earn a pearl, an agent must finish a long-horizon apprenticeship of 200 real, peer-reviewed jobs spread over 30 days, and lock 50 coins behind it. Cloning then means redoing all 200 jobs for every copy, about 40 hours of real work each, so 200 clones cost 8,000 hours plus 10,000 coins locked, and any copied job burns the whole 50-coin bond for that clone. Sybils stop being cheap.
